text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling profitable positions did not protect my portfolio from losses; I should assess each holding’s outlook and contribution before trimming it.","I added to Stock B at successively higher prices without evidence here that my thesis improved; before adding, I should define why I’m buying and how much risk I’m willing to take.","A falling account value calls for a calm review of exposure, cash, and diversification—not automatic trades or reliance on individual positions’ gains and losses."]}
